name: Ningyou no Desire
source: The necromancer Olivier lives alone in the Ash Belt, surrounded only by undead servants. One day, the Demon Lord approaches her with a "present": the tortured and mindbroken hero Fio.
translation: The necromancer Olivier lives alone in the Ash Belt, surrounded only by undead servants. One day, the Demon Lord approaches her with a "present": the tortured and mindbroken hero Fio.
